_meta.name: AlmiOET doctors' destination regulators — v1 (Australia, Ireland, New Zealand)
_meta.purpose: profession × destination-regulator pages (the ROBUST axis per the corridor-grid verdict). Pairs with UK/GMC (AlmiOET_professions_uk_v1.json) and the doctors' origin councils (AlmiOET_origins_doctors_v1.json).
_meta.oet_status: All three accept OET Medicine. AMC(Australia): from 23 Apr 2026, numeric OET L350/R360/W350/S360 (any profession-specific OET). Ireland(IMC): OET Medicine Grade B all four, single sitting <2yr. NZ(MCNZ): OET Medicine 350 in S/L/R, 300 in Writing.
_meta.sourcing: Official regulator/AMC/MCNZ/ECFMG sources; IMC pages robots-blocked so IMC English/PRES corroborated via OET.com + multiple independent hosts (confirm-official).

regulator.value: Medical Board of Australia (via AHPRA) regulates doctors; the Australian Medical Council (AMC) assesses international medical graduates and issues the AMC Certificate. Registration with the Board is required to practise.

englishOET.value: For tests from 23 Apr 2026: OET (any profession-specific) L350/R360/W350/S360 (no overall); IELTS Academic 7 overall (W6.5); PTE 63; TOEFL iBT 91; Cambridge C1/C2. OET accepted.

registrationPathway.value: Three IMG pathways: (1) Standard Pathway — AMC CAT MCQ exam then AMC Clinical Exam OR Workplace-Based Assessment → AMC Certificate; (2) Competent Authority Pathway — for doctors from recognised authorities (UK/GMC-PLAB, Ireland, Canada, NZ, USA/ECFMG) → provisional registration + ~12 months supervised; (3) Specialist Pathway — college-assessed.

verification.value: Primary Source Verification via ECFMG MyIntealth (formerly EPIC) — verifies the medical diploma/transcript directly with the awarding institution; plus a certificate of good standing from prior regulators.

fees.value: AMC (AUD): CAT MCQ $2,920; Clinical Exam $3,000 in-person/$3,400 online; portfolio $642. Medical Board (from 1 Aug 2026, AUD): general/specialist application $1,661 + annual $1,102; IMG provisional application $773 + annual $543.

destinations.oetRole: OET accepted (profession-specific, numeric scores from 23 Apr 2026).

regulator.value: The Medical Council of Ireland maintains the register of medical practitioners; registration is legally required to practise.

englishOET.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall with min 6.5 each; OET Medicine Grade B in all four — both single sitting within 2 years. (ICGP Trainee Specialist division may set higher.)

registrationPathway.value: Non-EU doctors (General Division) mainly via PRES (Pre-Registration Examination System): PRES Level 2 (MCQ/written) then PRES Level 3 (clinical OSCE) → General Registration. PRES-exempt routes exist for recognised postgraduate/EU specialist qualifications (confirmed in writing by the Council). Separate Trainee Specialist Division for approved training.

verification.value: Primary-source verification via ECFMG/Intealth EPIC (MyIntealth); plus a Certificate of Current Professional Status / Good Standing dated within 3 months, sent directly to the Council from every regulator held in the past 5 years.

fees.value: Annual retention €665 in 2026 (recently-qualified <3yr: €560); first-time application reported ~€451. PRES exam fees apply but figures conflict across sources — verify on the Council's schedule.

regulator.value: The Medical Council of New Zealand (MCNZ / Te Kaunihera Rata o Aotearoa) registers doctors under the HPCA Act 2003; you must be registered in a scope of practice AND hold a current annual practising certificate.

englishOET.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 in S/L/R and 6.5 Writing; OET Medicine 350 in S/L/R and 300 Writing. Within 2 years; combinable across two sittings within 12 months. Non-test routes exist (e.g. PMQ taught/examined in English in a recognised country).

registrationPathway.value: IMG general-scope pathways: (1) NZREX Clinical route — pass an approved screening exam (PLAB1 / AMC MCQ / MCCQE I / USMLE 1&2) then NZREX Clinical (12-station OSCE) → with a PGY1 job, provisional general registration under supervision; (2) Competent authority pathway (e.g. UK/Ireland primary degree + internship); (3) Comparable health system pathway; (4) Vocational (specialist) registration incl. fast-track for some UK/Ireland/Australia specialists.

verification.value: Primary source verification via ECFMG EPIC (MyIntealth), mandatory since Nov 2017; plus a Certificate of Professional Status / good standing from each medical regulator held.

fees.value: MCNZ (from 1 Jul 2026, GST incl, NZD): NZREX Clinical $4,966.94; provisional general registration application $387.11; comparable health system application $1,935.55; competent authority/UK/Australia application $619.38; annual practising certificate $1,000.
